status: DRAFT FOR THE AUTHOR'S APPROVAL. Not registered: no hash, no counter, and no data of the sample period (trades, minute bars or fund filings) has been downloaded or analysed. Registration requires the author's explicit approval, then a commit of its own with the hash and K1_unlock.json at 0, before step 1 is run.
question: In a real market, does the feedback certified from anonymous, tick-rule-signed trades track a feedback whose size is publicly disclosed? A leveraged or inverse ETF with daily leverage L and net assets A must trade A*L*(L-1)*R dollars in the direction of its underlying's return R since the previous close; for single-stock funds the hedge is traded in the stock itself, so each stock's disclosed rebalancing intensity is lambda_u = sum_funds A*L*(L-1) / ADV_u.
why_single_stocks: Index funds (TQQQ, SOXL) hedge largely in futures and swaps, so the rebalancing need not appear in the ETF underlying's trades, and one index gives no cross-section; single-stock funds give a cross-section in which lambda varies by orders of magnitude and the hedge must trade the stock.

data.funds: SEC Form N-PORT data sets 2026q1, 2026q2, 2026q3 (SUBMISSION, FUND_REPORTED_INFO): series name, series id, net assets, report date; reports dated 2025-12-31 to 2026-06-30, latest amendment; net assets averaged over a fund's reports
data.trades: Alpaca market-data API, consolidated (SIP) trades, two windows per full trading day: 13:30-14:00 ET (control) and 15:30-16:00 ET (close), excluding the 16:00 closing cross and trades with conditions O Q M 6 5 T U Z 4 W C N R 7 V P H L 9
data.daily: Alpaca SIP daily bars, raw and split-adjusted (previous close; split days dropped; ADV)
data.sample: full trading days 2026-01-02 to 2026-06-30; pre-period 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31 for the pool and control matching

universe_rule: Pool: active NYSE/NASDAQ/AMEX common stocks (names without ETF, fund, trust, shares, index, notes, warrants, units, rights, depositary, preferred) with median pre-period daily dollar volume >= $500M. Funds: N-PORT series whose name states a daily leveraged or inverse multiple (parse_leverage: numeric 'NX', Bull/Long positive, Bear/Short/Inverse negative, Ultra 2, UltraPro 3, inverse without multiple -1; L = 1 and income, option, buffer funds excluded) and names exactly one pool stock by ticker or company name and no index or sector (match_underlying). Treated: pool stocks with Lambda_u = sum A*L*(L-1) >= $100M per unit return. Controls: for each treated stock, largest Lambda first, the 2 nearest untreated pool stocks by standardized log median dollar volume and log daily volatility in the pre-period, without replacement; lambda = 0. The author may reject a fund-name match on reading it, with a written reason, only in step 1 and before any trades are downloaded; the universe file is then frozen.
inclusion: a window-day is valid if >= 90% of its 30 minutes have a trade; a stock enters if both windows are valid on >= 80% of sample days
construction: minute bars: last price, tick-rule signed dollar flow (sign carried over zero ticks, within the window), dollar volume; f = signed flow / the stock's median per-minute dollar volume over both windows; x = 1e4*log(price / previous close); r = 1e4 * one-minute log return, within window-day
primary_1: Detection. Per stock and window, phi from f_t = a + phi*x_{t-1} + sum_{j=1..5} rho_j f_{t-j} + e (pooled over valid days, lags within day); dPhi_u = phi(close) - phi(control). Spearman correlation of dPhi_u with lambda_u across included stocks positive, one-sided permutation p < 0.05 (20,000 permutations, seed 20261026).
primary_2: The margin. Per stock and window, the certificate M = -beta - kappa*sum_{m=1..12} k_m from r_t = c + kappa f_t + beta x_{t-1} and f_t = c' + sum k_m x_{t-m}; dM_u = M(close) - M(control). Spearman correlation of dM_u with lambda_u negative, one-sided permutation p < 0.05.
correction: Holm across the two primaries at 0.05
secondary: S1 visible share: dPhi_u * minute dollar volume * 30 / (Lambda_u * 1e-4), median over treated stocks (share of disclosed rebalancing traded in continuous trading in the last 30 minutes); expected between 0 and 1

S2 the default monitor (x = p - EMA_12 within the window): Spearman of its dM and dPhi with lambda; the memory-bound theorem predicts it sees less, because rebalancing responds to the day's return, a state older than its memory
S3 closing auction: slope of 1e4*log(close / last 15:59 price) on the 15:59 day displacement, Spearman with lambda positive (rebalancing executed in the closing cross; price only)
S4 lambda from bull funds only and from bear funds only
S5 days with absolute day return at or above the stock's median
S6 median dPhi of treated stocks and of matched controls

reading_stated_in_advance.both_pass: the certificate, computed without identifying anyone, tracks a feedback whose size is known from disclosures, across stocks
reading_stated_in_advance.P1_passes_P2_fails: the feedback is detected in anonymous flow but the margin is too noisy in 30-minute windows to rank stocks
reading_stated_in_advance.both_fail_S3_passes: the rebalancing is executed mainly in the closing auction, outside the continuous trades the certificate uses; K1 then cannot validate the certificate, it does not refute it
reading_stated_in_advance.both_fail_S3_fails: no trace of disclosed rebalancing in these windows; reported as a failure of K1

limits_stated_in_advance: much rebalancing may execute in the closing auction or be hedged by dealers with other instruments; the primaries see continuous trading only
net assets are quarter-end values; flows within a quarter are ignored, and creations and redemptions of the funds may offset part of the rebalancing (Lambda is gross demand)

high-lambda stocks are retail-heavy and volatile; controls are matched on volume and volatility and the close-minus-13:30 difference removes responses constant through the afternoon, but not closing-specific behaviour correlated with lambda; a pass is evidence that the certificate tracks disclosed feedback, not proof that the funds are its only source
tickers active at the universe date only (survivorship)

intraday momentum near the close is known (Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens, JFE 2021); K1's contribution is the anonymous certificate's agreement with a disclosed feedback size, not the existence of the pattern
designed_after: No data of the sample period. Synthetic calibration only (K1_null_calibration.json, k1_null_calibration.py): 75 synthetic stocks (25 treated, lambda lognormal, 50 controls), 120 days, with volatility and ordinary feedback rising with lambda and stronger order splitting near the close in every stock. Null (no rebalancing in continuous trading), 20 seeds: Primary 1 passed 1/20, Primary 2 0/20. Power, 10 seeds each, by the share of rebalancing executed in continuous trading in the last 30 minutes: 10%: P1 2/10, P2 0/10; 25%: P1 3/10, P2 0/10; 50%: P1 10/10, P2 6/10. S1 recovered the share (medians 0.15, 0.29, 0.54). A first calibration run was stopped and discarded because one synthetic stock's own loop was unstable; the simulator was fixed (commit 9246721) before the run reported here.
runs: step 4 (evaluate) runs once; K1_unlock.json counts runs
